## Accessibility Issue: [Pricing Page] — Weak focus indicator perimeter/contrast (WCAG 2.4.13)

**Bug ID:** `A11Y-f4a2b9c1` (instance) / `A11Y-d8e3a7f2` (pattern)
**URL:** https://staging.example.dev/pricing
**XPath:** `//button[@class='select-plan' and contains(@id, 'plans')]`
**Full DOM path:** `/html/body/main/div[@id='plans']/div[contains(@class, 'tier')]/button[@class='select-plan']`
**WCAG SC:** 2.4.13 — Focus Appearance (Level AAA)
**Rule:** keyboard-a11y-tester — focus-appearance-weak-desktop
**Severity:** Low
**Frequency:** 4 instances on this page
**Screen type:** desktop | **Colour mode:** light

### HTML Snippet
```html
<!-- N/A (not provided in source scan) -->
```

### Description
Four interactive pricing tier selection buttons (`#plans > div.tier:nth-of-type(1) > button.select-plan`, `#plans > div.tier:nth-of-type(2) > button.select-plan`, `#billing-toggle > button.annual`, and a duplicate instance) have visible focus indicators that do not meet AAA requirements for Focus Appearance. The indicators lack sufficient perimeter area (>= 2px) and/or contrast ratio (>= 3:1 against adjacent colors), making them difficult to perceive during keyboard navigation.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Navigate to https://staging.example.dev/pricing
2. Use the `Tab` key to move focus sequentially through the pricing tier selection buttons
3. Observe the focus indicator on each button (e.g., `#plans > div.tier:nth-of-type(1) > button.select-plan`)
4. Note the visual contrast and perimeter width of the active focus state

### Expected Behaviour
Focus indicators meet AAA criteria: visible perimeter area >= 2px and contrast ratio >= 3:1 against adjacent colors, clearly distinguishing the focused element from its default state.

### Actual Behaviour
Focus indicators have insufficient contrast (ranging from 1.98:1 to 2.41:1) and/or insufficient perimeter width, making them hard to perceive for low-vision users tracking keyboard focus across the pricing tiers.

### Testing Environment
| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Browser | N/A (automated keyboard tester) |
| OS | N/A (automated keyboard tester) |
| Screen reader | N/A (keyboard-only test) |
| Testing tool | keyboard-a11y-tester |
| Confidence | 0.5 (medium) — automated measurement; manual verification recommended for contrast/perimeter accuracy |

### Impact
Low-vision keyboard users may lose track of their current position on the page. Users relying on magnification tools, high-contrast modes, or cognitive load reduction strategies may find the focus state indistinguishable from the default state, degrading navigation efficiency and increasing error rates.

### Suggested Fix (optional)
Increase focus indicator contrast to at least 3:1 against adjacent colors and ensure a visible perimeter of at least 2px (or equivalent area). Example CSS remediation:
```css
button.select-plan:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #005fcc;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
#billing-toggle button.annual:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #005fcc;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
```
Ensure the chosen color maintains >= 3:1 contrast against both the default background and adjacent sibling elements.
